# Layer stacking

Every axiom layer namespace, from `LayerStack.layers`: Hyprland's layer rules (`HyprLua.layerRulesLua`), and the order axiom maps its surfaces in elsewhere ([layer arrangement](../compositor/layer-arrangement.md)). Higher `order` is arranged (and drawn) first: closer to the screen edge, and it takes a shared corner. Hyprland reads `order` only as a surface maps. Cite this page rather than repeating the numbers in a doc.

| Namespace | Order | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `axiom-border-shadow` | 11 | The border's inward shadow window: under every other axiom surface, the overlay backdrop included. |
| `axiom-backdrop` | 10 | Each screen's backdrop window (ScreenBackdrop: full-screen surfaces' dim background): on Top, under the bars and border. Without layer rules it stays mapped (held), so it keeps its place before them. |
| `axiom-blur-backing` | 9 | The blur window (BlurManager, shell/BlurBacking), drawing the chrome's fills under it. |
| `axiom-edge-menu` | 7 | An integrated edge menu: arranged before the bars and border, so it sits at the screen edge and pushes them and the windows inwards. |
| `axiom-popout-under` | 6 | Detached popouts and floating edge menus: drawn under the bars and border, so they slide out from beneath them. |
| `axiom-bar` | 5 | Solid bars, on the screen's shorter edge: arranged before the border, whose strip then lands on the bar's inner part. Of two bars at a corner the one arranged first takes it (BarEnds). |
| `axiom-bar-long` | 4 | Solid bars on the screen's longer edge: after the shorter edge's, so they make way at a shared corner. |
| `axiom-border` | 0 | The screen border (Hyprland's default order, written for the record). |
| `axiom-bar-pill` | -1 | Pill bars: after the border (inside it, drawn over its stroke), before every other kind of bar. |
| `axiom-bar-pill-long` | -2 | Pill bars on the longer edge. |
| `axiom-bar-transparent` | -3 | Transparent bars: make way for solid and pill bars. |
| `axiom-bar-transparent-long` | -4 | Transparent bars on the longer edge. |
| `axiom-bar-floating` | -5 | Floating bars and floating pills: make way for every other bar. |
| `axiom-bar-floating-long` | -6 | Floating bars on the longer edge: the last bar. |
| `axiom-dock` | -7 | Docks: after every bar and the border on their edge, so they sit inside them. |
| `axiom-overlay` | -8 | The overlay's panel: after docks, inside an always-shown dock's zone and over a hover or intellihide one. |
| `axiom-blur-backing-overlay` | -9 | The blur window over the overlay (shell/BlurBacking, while the overlay is open on its screen), drawing the fills of the Overlay-layer surfaces above it: after the overlay, before them. Mapped at once, so the fills it draws under content already showing don't fade in. (no animation) |
| `axiom-osd` | -10 | The OSD: after the overlay, so a volume or brightness change shows over it. |
| `axiom-dock-preview` | -10 | A dock's preview (the settings card's Show): after the overlay, so it shows over the settings page. |
| `axiom-edge-popout` | -11 | Edge popouts (floating edge menus): after the dock and the OSD, so a menu opened over the overlay draws over both. |
| `axiom-popout` | -11 | Bar popouts: over the bars they open from. |
| `axiom-screenshot` | -20 | The screenshot picker's frozen frame: appears and goes at once, no fade, over everything (popups can't be ordered: see captureFrozen). (no animation) |
| `axiom-monitor-prompt` | -25 | The monitor layout prompt (Keep / Revert): after the picker, over the overlay the Monitors page opened it from. |
| `axiom-polkit` | -30 | The polkit prompt: after everything, so nothing of axiom's draws over a password prompt. |
| `axiom-desktop` |  | Desktop widgets: no fade in or out. (no animation) |
